content:
Ravi (Head of Growth): quick sync — weekly KPI review. Dashboard looks up overall but attribution shakeup after the benchmark post. see: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/weekly-kpi :eyes:
Nora (Demand Gen): Saw that. Sessions +22% but MQLs flat. wondering if last-click is understating assisted channels (webinar partners, benchmarks).
Diego (Analytics): pulling attribution breakdown now. last-click shows paid display driving most MQLs; multi-touch gives more credit to webinar + partners.
Priya (Content): We swapped the benchmark post CTA to a short-form demo vs register a week ago. Could affect lead quality.
Diego (Analytics): quick sample export:
```
date,utm_source,utm_campaign,leads,mqls,demo_bookings
2026-03-22,organic,benchmark-post,280,18,6
2026-03-22,paid,benchmark-ads,410,29,10
2026-03-23,partners,benchmark-webinar,95,5,1
```
Diego (Analytics): If we use linear attribution, the webinar gets +12% credit for MQLs. But conversion-to-demo for webinar leads is lower, which pulls down aggregate quality.
Nora (Demand Gen): Are webinar leads being routed to partner pipeline or our inbound flow? That routing change last month might hide their downstream conversions. cc @Eve Ops @routing-bot
routing-bot: rule-check: utm_source=partners -> pipeline:partner_flow (created 2026-02-25 by Eve Ops)
Eve Ops: confirmed. current rule moves those to partner_flow. We can add a mirror tag for analytics (partner_tag=true) without changing pipeline.
Ravi (Head of Growth): Let's not move traffic mid-week. Proposed experiment: for 7 days, keep routing but add mirrored leads to inbound-test with tag=partner_mirror. Then run per-utm campaign funnel and attribution (last-click vs linear). Nora, Priya — can you pause any new CTAs that send exclusively to partners for 48h so we have a clean baseline?
Priya (Content): I can pause the partner-only CTA on the benchmark post and change the copy back to demo-first for the site hero. Will push in 30m.
Nora (Demand Gen): I'll pause the partner co-marketing email scheduled for tomorrow morning.
Diego (Analytics): I'll add two dashboard tiles: "Attribution lens: last-click vs linear" and "Partner mirror funnel". ETA 4 hours. Will also add minimum sample size warning.
Eve Ops: mirror tag scheduled: partner_mirror=true for incoming leads with utm_source=partners starting 2026-03-24T08:00:00Z for 7 days (created by Eve Ops).
Ravi (Head of Growth): OK action list: Diego (tiles + exports), Eve (mirror tag), Priya/Nora (pause CTAs/emails). We reconvene Friday AM during KPI standup. If demo conversion improves >10% for benchmark-post cohort under mirrored routing, we investigate permanent routing changes.
Nora (Demand Gen): +1 :thumbsup:
Diego (Analytics): added tiles and saved views. link: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/widgets/attribution-lens — note: linear model increases partner credit but sample size for partners is small, CI wide.
Priya (Content): CTA reverted on site hero. left a note in the content doc.
Ravi (Head of Growth): Great. Also can someone add a small note in the KPI doc about which attribution model we used for the executive summary? We should avoid confusing the board.
Diego (Analytics): done. wrote: "Executive KPI uses last-click by default. See attribution-lens for multi-touch comparisons"
Ravi (Head of Growth): perfect. I'll flag this for Friday. If you see any weird spikes or mis-routed leads, drop here.
